name: Swansea

neighborhoods.name: Uplands
neighborhoods.homes: Victorian terraced houses and student shared houses

housing: Swansea's rentals are mostly terraced houses, many shared by students in Uplands and Brynmill, with flats in the city centre and Marina.

localRules.text: Every private landlord letting a home in Wales must register with Rent Smart Wales, and a landlord who manages the home themselves (or their agent) also needs a licence.
Deposits in Wales must be put in a government-backed tenancy deposit scheme within 30 days of the landlord receiving them.

tenantHelp.name: Shelter Cymru
tenantHelp.what: free housing advice charity in Wales

climate: Check for damp and mould, and photograph gutters and window seals; Swansea is one of the wetter UK cities.
universities: University of Wales Trinity Saint David
fact: Uplands and Brynmill are Swansea's main student areas, so many shared-house lets run from summer to summer.
